notes: Web 441 — PHOTO-VAULT-NOV12 (Nov 12, 2026; layers on web 440). Owner evidence: today's Mobil receipt (63.370 L, $133.65, odo 172,903) previewed, the fill saved, and the photo was shed at the save — the app said it "didn't fit in this device's app storage" — on a phone with ~118 GB free. His ruling: the app "has to store thousands if not hundreds of thousands of pictures. So make sure that this space issue is not happening ever again." ROOT (the v372 trace's accounting, re-measured by v394): every book lives in the origin's localStorage with every photo inline as base64, and Chromium caps the WHOLE origin at 10 MiB counted in UTF-16 bytes — at the app's rendition sizes (~180-260k chars a photo) some two dozen photos fill the pool, and from then on any save that must grow the store can die: fuel receipts (Nov 5/7/9/12), a Documents filing, a signed PTI, a dispatch close. The device was never the wall; the pool was. FIX — THE PHOTO VAULT (new js/photovault.js; the store.get door in js/app.js; App._photoDl's reference branch; two guards in modules/fuel.js; 'photos' joins FB.OWN_COLLECTIONS in js/firebase.js): a photo's bytes live in the ACCOUNT — users/{uid}/photos documents keyed by the payload's SHA-256 (the same photo is stored once however many records use it), chunked past one document's reach with the manifest written last as the commit point — and are cached on the device in IndexedDB, whose quota is a share of the disk, not the 10 MiB pool. The record keeps a reference (mtphoto://) where the data URL sat. A background sweep migrates every inline photo in every book into the vault and rewrites the book slim through App._store.set, so cloud sync carries the slim book like any other write; a photo leaves a book only once its bytes are confirmed in the account or in the device vault, and a book changed under the sweep is retried next round. Existing photos therefore migrate themselves on the first runs after this build lands, the local pool drains to facts and references, and no photo can ever fill it again — photos now survive cache clears, force-stops and device changes, because a book arriving by sync on any signed-in device resolves its references from the account on first paint. Readers never change their habits: store.get resolves references to cached bytes at the one door every module reads through, a MutationObserver painter swaps any the moment its bytes land, and the Download button resolves a reference before delivering. Fuel's own economy (photo documents, fit ladder, reclaim, relief) stands untouched except two guards: the relief shedder and the photo-doc audit now skip reference-sized stacks — a reference IS the shed state, and the audit must never overwrite a full photo document with a pointer. Firebase Storage is deliberately NOT used: this project has no storage bucket (probed Nov 12, 2026 — both bucket names answer "The specified bucket does not exist") and creating one means moving the project to the pay-as-you-go plan, which is the owner's decision, not this fix's; Firestore is already live on the free plan. BENCH: new tools/photovault-v441-test.js 36/36 — Phase 0 reproduces the wall on pre-fix semantics (book + the REAL Nov 12 receipt refused by the real store; the photo-less retry lands, entry photo-less); migration drains the calibrated pool ~9.9 MB to under 1.5 MB with every seeded photo resolving byte-identical from the account alone after restart + cache wipe and every non-photo field byte-identical; the Nov 12 fill with the real receipt saves through the real store, stores a reference, and shows the receipt byte-for-byte after restart + cache wipe; scale: 215 photos (150 fills, 40 expenses, 25 documents) accumulated in waves — no save refused, pool slim, all 215 resolve byte-identical from the account alone; the real 791k-char odometer photo rides as a 2-chunk manifest (a synthetic 1.6M-char payload as 3 chunks), byte-identical; a photo stored signed-out lives in the device vault and reaches the account on the first sweep after sign-in. REGRESSION: 14 targeted suites (storage-wall, account-delete, photo-download, the fuel photo line v332-v373, cloudsync, close-echo) on pristine 440 vs 441 — every count identical except fuel-photo-travel-nov11's index pin, which moves with this release's fuel.js pin (426 -> 441); all other deltas are the standing era webVersion pins that fail on both trees. PIN MOVES: index.html gains js/photovault.js?v=441 right after firebase.js; js/firebase.js 276 -> 441, modules/fuel.js 426 -> 441, js/app.js 440 -> 441. NO NATIVE CHANGE (the OTA manifest carries the new file). VERDICT OWED IN HIS HANDS: after the update lands, open Fuel — older entries show their receipt photos; attach a fresh receipt at the pump, save, fully close and reopen the app — the photo is there, and the didn't-fit note should never appear again.
